careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.short_description: Architect, design, and build resilient web apps, systems, and software solutions.
careers.description: Software Engineers translate complex real-world requirements into clean, scalable software architecture. You will work with front-end frameworks, back-end APIs, cloud infrastructure, and databases to deliver user-centric applications.
responsibilities: Write clean, testable, and robust TypeScript / Python code
Collaborate with product designers and engineering teams on architecture
Build APIs and integrate database persistence layers
Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and optimize applications
careers.work_style: Collaborative problem solving, agile sprints, high autonomy
careers.why_it_matches: Your high aptitude in computational reasoning (94%) and proven passion for building technology products (92%) make Software Engineering an outstanding natural alignment. Your strong foundations in Python and problem solving give you an immediate competitive advantage.
careers.recommended_next_step: Reinforce SQL database modeling and complete intermediate Data Structures to boost interview readiness.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.short_description: Extract statistical insights, build predictive models, and guide decisions with data.
careers.description: Data Scientists combine programming skills, statistical knowledge, and machine learning techniques to uncover patterns and actionable predictions from massive datasets.
responsibilities: Develop machine learning models and statistical pipelines
Query large datasets with SQL and analyze data using Python/Pandas
Communicate data-driven recommendations to executive stakeholders
Design experiments, A/B tests, and metric evaluation frameworks
careers.work_style: Deep analytical investigation, hypothesis testing, cross-functional storytelling
careers.why_it_matches: Your analytical mindset and strong Python capabilities are well suited for Data Science. Bridging your SQL and applied statistics knowledge will quickly bring your readiness to the 90%+ tier.
careers.recommended_next_step: Take the SQL Fundamentals and Applied Statistics learning modules.

careers.title: Product Manager
careers.short_description: Define product vision, rally engineering & design, and lead product launches.
careers.description: Product Managers sit at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and user experience, defining what features get built and why.
responsibilities: Define product roadmap, user stories, and measurable OKRs
Interview users to discover pain points and validate solutions
Coordinate cross-functional development with engineers and designers
Analyze product analytics to guide iterations
careers.work_style: Stakeholder communication, strategic planning, team facilitation
careers.why_it_matches: Your high empathy, problem-solving skills, and tech aptitude provide a solid platform for product leadership, particularly in tech-driven startups.
careers.recommended_next_step: Engage in team project leadership and practice structured product interview frameworks.

careers.title: UI/UX Product Designer
careers.short_description: Design intuitive interfaces, user workflows, and delightful digital experiences.
careers.description: Product Designers research customer journeys, sketch wireframes, create interactive prototypes, and craft design systems that delight users.
responsibilities: Design intuitive flows, wireframes, and interactive mockups
Conduct usability testing with students and users
Collaborate with frontend engineers on design system consistency
Advocate for accessibility and clean visual hierarchy
careers.work_style: Creative visual exploration, iterative user testing, empathetic design
careers.why_it_matches: Your eye for structure and enthusiasm for building useful tools translates well into design, though technical engineering remains your highest scoring fit.
careers.recommended_next_step: Explore UX prototyping tools and design hierarchy fundamentals.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.short_description: Protect systems, audit networks, and defend applications from cyber vulnerabilities.
careers.description: Cybersecurity Analysts assess threat vectors, audit code and network topology, and respond to incidents to safeguard sensitive student and corporate data.
responsibilities: Conduct penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
Monitor network traffic and implement intrusion detection systems
Educate teams on security hygiene and secure coding practices
Formulate incident response plans and recovery workflows
careers.work_style: Analytical defense, high attention to detail, protocol rigor
careers.why_it_matches: Your strong deductive problem-solving score aligns naturally with security auditing and threat defense logic.
careers.recommended_next_step: Review TCP/IP networking fundamentals and secure coding paradigms.
